author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys, so Awarrior contacted me about a week ago, and had this idea to make a dualtage, since he still records sometimes but discontinued his channel. I thought it was a great idea, and got to work recording and editing, adding in his clips. Here is the final result:

http://youtu.be/h5cpggO8XbY


The first few clips were from me, and his clips start at Fissura. Sorry for the video being a bit short; I didn't really have that many clips available :P

If you liked this video, please remember to leave a like and subscribe for more! Enjoy :D
